facts.fact: UGPE reports an upgrade of SYDONIA World at Cape Verde's customs offices, including migration to version 4.4.0 and new customs modules, in a project running November 2023 to July 2026.

note: Workshop release names the country as a participant only; no customs system status stated.

facts.fact: ASYCUDA reports that Cabo Verde launched the ASYVAL valuation control module in ASYCUDAWorld in March 2025, which flags deviating import declarations automatically and raised customs revenue by 2.49% on average across 12 product categories.

systems.country_label: ASYCUDAWorld with ASYVAL valuation control module

facts.fact: Cabo Verde hosted an ECOWAS mission on 18-21 November 2024 to implement the SIGMAT transit system, and customs chose the SIGMAT mobile version for inter-island transit.

note: ECOWAS says SIGMAT is not yet functional in Cabo Verde; no customs value fits.
